canonicalFacts.claim: Multiple sclerosis is an autoimmune demyelinating and neurodegenerative disease of the central nervous system and the leading cause of nontraumatic neurological disability in young adults
About 10-15% of patients with multiple sclerosis present with primary-progressive disease characterized by gradually increasing neurological disability
Four sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor modulators (fingolimod, ozanimod, ponesimod, and siponimod) are approved by the FDA for multiple sclerosis treatment
Ocrelizumab showed efficacy in reducing disability progression in primary progressive multiple sclerosis
Clinically significant depression can affect up to 50% of patients with multiple sclerosis over their lifetime

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Address low vitamin D levels, cigarette smoking cessation, and obesity management as environmental factors that drive multiple sclerosis

redFlags: Daclizumab was withdrawn from the market due to safety concerns
Natalizumab carries risk of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy requiring careful monitoring
S1P receptor modulators require continued and regular monitoring during treatment

excludedAgents.name: High-dose vitamin D (cholecalciferol)
excludedAgents.reason: Failed to show efficacy in reducing disease activity in patients with clinically isolated syndrome typical for multiple sclerosis in randomized placebo-controlled trial

excludedAgents.name: Fluoxetine
excludedAgents.reason: Failed to slow accumulation of disability in progressive multiple sclerosis in phase 2 trial examining time to confirmed increase in walking or dexterity tests

excludedAgents.name: Fampridine
excludedAgents.reason: Showed no significant benefit in patients with multiple sclerosis in acute phase of cervical transverse myelitis in randomized placebo-controlled trial

excludedAgents.name: Lisdexamfetamine
excludedAgents.reason: Failed to show significant improvement in fatigue in multiple sclerosis patients in randomized double-blind placebo-controlled study

excludedAgents.name: Oral prednisone
excludedAgents.reason: Showed no benefit compared to placebo for acute optic neuritis treatment in randomized controlled trial
